title: [Bug]: `generate_init_message` fails for multimodal model.
body: ### Describe the bug Note that the second method (in the bottom) does not work today, because of recent updates in generate_init_message ```python image_agent = MultimodalConversableAgent( name="image-explainer", max_consecutive_auto_reply=10, llm_config={"config_list": config_list_4v, "temperature": 0.5, "max_tokens": 300}, ) user_proxy = autogen.UserProxyAgent( name="User_proxy", system_message="A human admin.", human_input_mode="NEVER", # Try between ALWAYS or NEVER max_consecutive_auto_reply=0, code_execution_config={ "use_docker": False }, # Please set use_docker=True if docker is available to run the generated code.
